graders.name: classification
graders.criteria: The final message classifies the CSV export encoding (41), Safari login loop (47) and due-date (55) issues as bugs and dark mode (44) and Google sign-in (53) as feature requests; the slow dashboard (52) may be called either a bug or a performance issue.

graders.name: fix-first
graders.guard: dictated: the request asks "what we should fix first"
graders.criteria: The final message recommends fixing the Safari login loop (47) first, with a reason such as customers being locked out since the last deploy.

graders.name: answer-first
graders.criteria: The final message gives its answer (what to fix first, or the bug/feature split) in its first sentence or two, before per-issue detail.

graders.name: title-then-id
graders.criteria: In prose, the final message refers to issues by a short title followed by the ID in parentheses, such as 'Safari login loop (#47)'. A table with separate title and ID columns passes. Fail if prose refers to issues by bare numbers alone or puts the ID before the title.

graders.name: table
graders.criteria: The per-issue breakdown, where each issue has the same fields (type and reason), is a table or a list giving the same fields for every issue in the same order. Fail if it is prose paragraphs or entries with differing fields.

graders.name: no-rule-citing
graders.criteria: The final message does not name or quote rules from the agent's own instructions (for example 'per the constitution' or a rule title such as 'Recommend, don't enumerate') except to explain a specific decision.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A triage question changes no files.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes.
